blog.para1:
This week's blog got put through a comeback fight it never asked for.
A final girl dragged back into the ring, Nolan's ten-year road trip, and a Bourdain biopic that treats the kitchen like the last thirty seconds of a close round.
Mouthguard in, let's go.

films.title: The Odyssey (2026)
films.hook: The movie blog is live and this week it went twenty years out of its way to get home.
films.excerpt: This is Nolan's crack at Homer, and whatever else gets said about it, the film understands that the point of the Odyssey was never really the monsters. It's the distance. Everyone remembers the monsters. The story is actually the twenty-year distraction from getting home, dressed up as heroism the whole way there.

films.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma (Horror Deep Dive)
films.hook: The movie blog is live and this week it dragged horror's toughest survivor back for a rematch she never wanted.
films.excerpt: The final girl has always been horror's version of the fighter who's still standing in round twelve, not because she hit hardest but because she absorbed everything thrown at her and simply refused to go down. Nobody remembers the exact combination that ended it. They remember that she was still upright when the credits rolled.
